newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bishop Belo conducts Mass as peace prize announced.
newsitem.headline: Bishop Belo conducts Mass as peace prize announced.

text.p: East Timor's Roman Catholic Bishop Carlos Filipe Ximenes Belo was holding a Mass at a school in the territory's capital of Dili on Friday when it was announced he was the joint winner of the Nobel Peace Prize.

"He is giving a Mass to about 2,000 to 3,000 people in a school in Dili," Brother Santos, a colleague, told Reuters by phone. He said Belo had not yet been told that he had jointly won the prize with East Timor resistance leader Jose Ramos-Horta.
Brother Santos said he had heard through the Internet and from other sources that Belo had won the prize but was awaiting confirmation.
"Belo himself does not know yet," he said.
Indonesia and Portugal have been at loggerheads over East Timor since Indonesia invaded the former Portugese colony in 1975 and subsequently annexed it in defiance of the United Nations.
The United Nations still recognises Lisbon as the administering power.
